title: Intel Hits Ohio Chip Fab Milestone 5 Years Behind Schedule
summary:
The semiconductor firm has advanced its domestic manufacturing efforts by completing a construction stage at its plant in Ohio. This progression is a step forward for the fabrication facility, which is currently at least 5 years behind its original timeline.

The milestone follows years of setbacks to the project as Intel works to expand its footprint of fabrication sites within the United States. The company has faced multiple delays in bringing the Ohio fab online as part of its broader strategy to increase US chip production.
